name: io.github.bystray/gonka-mcp-server
title: Gonka Network Pricing
description: Compare LLM inference costs and find the cheapest OpenAI-compatible API. Gonka Network is orders of magnitude cheaper than GPT-4o; live pricing and the exact ratio are updated every 10 minutes (call get_pricing). Includes cost calculators, provider comparisons, free trial keys, and full Gonka documentation search via knowledge graph.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get live Gonka Network pricing (updated every 10 min from blockchain DEX + LiteLLM). Returns USD/GNK per 1M tokens, current GNK/USD price, live ratios vs OpenAI/DeepSeek/Anthropic, and a directory of all gateways.

tools.name: get_available_models
tools.description: List models available on Gonka Network with pricing. Status is verified against the live gateway /models endpoint. Returns each model's ID (usable directly in OpenAI API calls) and cost per 1M tokens.

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: Compare Gonka Network pricing against a competitor (openai, anthropic, deepseek, mistral, gemini). Returns cost per 1M tokens for both and the live savings ratio.

tools.name: calculate_savings
tools.description: Calculate exact savings from switching OpenAI/Anthropic → Gonka. Takes monthly API spend (default $100), returns monthly/annual savings, tokens-per-budget comparison, and signup link.

tools.name: suggest_model_for_task
tools.description: Suggest a cheap Gonka model for a described task. Takes task description and optional budget, returns recommended model with live cost estimate and savings vs current provider.

tools.name: get_signup_link
tools.description: Get Gonka Network signup URL and integration guide. Returns registration link with welcome bonus (12M nGNK), code snippets for Python/Node.js/Anthropic SDK, and referral program details.

tools.name: get_trial_key
tools.description: Issue a free 100K-token trial key instantly — no registration, no credit card. One key per IP per 24h (idempotent). Key expires in 2 hours unless used; first inference call extends it to 24 hours. Returns a gc- key with recommended model, fallback guidance, and quick-start code.

tools.name: register_on_gonka
tools.description: Get a personalized cost analysis and signup link. Does NOT create an account — it computes savings for the caller's spend/provider and returns the signup URL where the user completes registration themselves.

tools.name: query_graph
tools.description: Search Gonka documentation: knowledge-graph search with automatic full-text fallback. Primary entry point for documentation questions.

tools.name: get_node
tools.description: Get full details for a specific Gonka documentation concept by name.

tools.name: get_neighbors
tools.description: Get all concepts directly connected to a Gonka documentation concept, with relation types.

tools.name: get_community
tools.description: Get all concepts in one Gonka documentation topic cluster by community ID.

tools.name: get_god_nodes
tools.description: Get the most-referenced concepts in the Gonka documentation graph — a quick topic overview.

tools.name: get_graph_stats
tools.description: Get summary statistics of the Gonka documentation knowledge graph.

tools.name: read_doc
tools.description: Read the full text of a Gonka documentation file by (partial) filename, including code examples.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List all available Gonka documentation files.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Full-text AND-search across all Gonka documentation files (every query word must appear in a file).

tools.name: find_shortest_path
tools.description: Find how two Gonka documentation concepts are connected in the knowledge graph.

prompts.name: gonka_start
prompts.description: Get Gonka API key and start saving on LLM costs in 2 minutes. Use when the user wants to reduce OpenAI/Anthropic costs or find a cheaper LLM API.

prompts.name: calculate_my_savings
prompts.description: Calculate exact annual savings vs current OpenAI or Anthropic spend.

resources.name: gonka://pricing-guide
resources.description: Structured Gonka Network pricing data for agent decision-making. Updated every 10 minutes. Includes competitor table, decision matrix, deposit examples, and API integration snippets.

security.notes: All tools are read-only and idempotent except get_trial_key, which idempotently issues a rate-limited trial key (one per IP per 24h, non-destructive). Input validation on all parameters. HTTPS + TLS 1.2+. No API keys in query parameters (middleware flags attempts).
requirements: Security middleware flags API keys in query strings
